description: "Mental health needs to be a public health priority in Tennessee if we want to end the opioid crisis, reduce crime, and solve homelessness. Farmers, first responders, and veterans also currently lack the care they need to do the jobs we depend on them to do. It's time we invested seriously in our mental wellbeing to make sure our towns and workers never find themselves alone in a crisis."

title: Mental Health
